name: m4-gameplay-branches
description: The declared required gameplay branches for the M4 acceptance term GAMEPLAY_RELIABILITY ('every declared required gameplay branch runs without an unexpected runtime failure', docs/STATUS.md). scripts/m4_check.py derives each branch's state only from checks it actually ran in the same invocation: a branch with no covering check is UNCOVERED, and GAMEPLAY_RELIABILITY is never PASS while any required branch is UNCOVERED, any covering check did not run or failed, or any blocking inventory item is open. A covering check proves only what its scenario exercises, under one fixed clock and seed.
list_status: PROVISIONAL (conservative reading, 2026-11-25): the six categories are the ones epic #163 names (combat, death and recovery, timers, objects, scoring, save/load); the branches inside each are this file's reading of PLAN M4 'Build' and of the failure inventory's unexercised areas. The maintainer has not yet approved a final required-branch list. Adding a branch can only turn the term away from PASS.
checks_namespace: Each entry in `checks` is a make target listed in tests/scenarios/m4-manifest.json (scenarios, persistence or playable_subchecks). Discovery runs that are not gated checks (tests/scenarios/failure-inventory-cases.json) are cited in `evidence_only` and never count as coverage.

The CLOCKER's whole event list is checkpointed every turn. The candle clock CNDIN is queued and fired too (coal-machine and gas-room: CANDLES queues it at `take candles`; its first 50-tick interval ends in coal-machine at entry 90) and checkpointed by the puzzles profile, as evidence beyond the two cited checks; the balloon clocks BINT and BRNIN are recorded natively only (balloon-ledge, blocked by INV-12). Not reached in this runtime: the balloon (BINT, BRNIN), fuse (FUSIN), ledge (LEDIN), safe (SAFIN), gnome (VLGIN, GNOIN), bucket (BCKIN) and sphere (SPHIN) clocks

branches.note: UNCOVERED by this file's reading (five puzzles are listed and four are exercised; read as strictly as combat.thief). Exercised under the fixed clock and seed: FOUR listed puzzles. The boat (boat-river): the pump fetched from Reservoir North, the folded boat inflated with it at the Dam Base (IBOAT-FUNCTION 77act2.mud:285), boarded, launched onto the River Frigid (RIVR1 only), landed, left, deflated and taken. The dam (dam-sluice; reachable since INV-11 was fixed, #193): the wrench, the bolt refused without GATE-FLAG, the yellow button, the bolt turned (BOLT-FUNCTION 77act1.mud:701: the sluice gates open, LOW-TIDE), the trunk taken from the drained reservoir, across the reservoir bed. The coal-mine machine and basket (coal-machine): the coal carried up from the Dead End, put in the basket with the screwdriver and the burning candles and lowered (DUMBWAITER 77act2.mud:74, CAGE-TOP false), the empty-handed passage from the Timber Room (NO-OBJS, EMPTY-HANDED) to the Lower Shaft lit by the candles (LIGHT-SHAFT scored), the machine's lid, the switch turned with the screwdriver (MSWITCH-FUNCTION 77act2.mud:139: the coal becomes the diamond), the diamond put in the basket and raised (CAGE-TOP T). The gas room (gas-room): BOOM-ROOM (77act2.mud:3) on walking in with the lamp only (nothing happens; the bracelet taken) and with the burning candles (the coal-gas explosion, JIGS-UP, patched). NOT exercised in this runtime: the balloon. Its native reference (balloon-ledge: the guidebook burned in the receptacle, the balloon risen to the Narrow Ledge, the wire tied to the hook and untied, the balloon landed again) is committed, but this runtime stops on boarding it (INV-12: BALLOON's attached #DECL (PRSO) <OR OBJECT DIRECTION>, 77act2.mud:424-425, meets the #FALSE () that CLOCK-DEMON leaves in PRSVEC at the vehicle's READ-OUT call; pinned Confusion checks no attached declaration); tracked by xfail-m4-balloon-frontier, not counted. Also not exercised: the river downstream (RIVR2 on, the falls, the buoy), the reservoir refilling, the gas room's ON branch (a flame lit inside), the volcano gnome. The maintainer may split this branch into one branch per puzzle; four would then be covered and the balloon would remain, blocked by INV-12
